svg.text: V2X ECU call flow, 3 of 3 — deduplication, construction and forwarding
The final two stages convert the wire message into the object message the ADA node consumes.
discard repeats within the configured time window
derive distance from the x and y offsets
convert confidences and units; derive sender speed
arrival, decode, and forwarding events recorded
read from the node log, not transmitted
Distance is computed here rather than transmitted, so the transmitted position and
the derived distance cannot disagree. Sender speed is null until the second message.
